SELECT doc_no docNo, doc_title docTitle, emp_name empName, doc_content docContent, status, createdate FROM document INNER JOIN emp ON document.emp_id = emp.emp_id WHERE emp.emp_id = ( SELECT emp_id FROM emp WHERE emp_id = #{empId} )
AND doc_title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchWord}, '%')
AND emp.emp_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchName}, '%')
ORDER BY createdate DESC

SELECT doc_no docNo, doc_title docTitle, emp_name empName, doc_content docContent, status, createdate FROM document INNER JOIN emp ON document.emp_id = emp.emp_id WHERE emp.emp_id IN ( SELECT emp_id FROM emp WHERE dept = ( SELECT dept FROM emp WHERE emp_id = #{empId} ) )
AND doc_title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchWord}, '%')
AND emp.emp_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchName}, '%')
ORDER BY createdate DESC LIMIT #{beginRow}, #{rowPerPage}

SELECT DISTINCT document.doc_no docNo, doc_title docTitle, emp_name empName, doc_content docContent, status, document.createdate FROM document INNER JOIN emp ON document.emp_id = emp.emp_id INNER JOIN sign ON document.doc_no = sign.doc_no
AND doc_title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchWord}, '%')
AND emp.emp_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchName}, '%')
ORDER BY createdate DESC
